diagnosis: ObjectTagDisassociateView deletes a TaggedItem record representing an association between a tag and an application entity. The query TaggedItem.objects.get(id=tagged_item_id) performs no authorization verification on the underlying content_object. An attacker can iterate over tagged_item_id integers to strip classification, compliance, and governance tags from records owned by other accounts across the platform.
